measured_outcome: Recall improved on a fresh scripted lab cohort, but independent-source acceptance failed. The new large GLU remains worse than the previous small MLP on SR-BH. No universal improvement or deployment readiness is claimed.

method.bounded76: Retain all 70 observed numbers and add six minimum-count syntax interactions. Flags/ratios remain unchanged; other nonnegative values use log1p(v)/(1+log1p(v)). No fitted moments, vocabulary or test labels enter preprocessing.
method.calibration: Use the unchanged maximum of source-specific benign calibration quantiles at target FPR 1%. Validation eligibility requires observed FPR <=1% in every source. No threshold is chosen or refitted using either new quality cohort.
method.experimental_security45: Fixed log1p syntax counters and interactions, with route, method and length removed. Benign source-probe balanced accuracy fell from 98.79% to 76.92%, but the encoding created 12 mixed-label vector groups and at least 1,249 fitting-role label disagreements. It is not adopted as the default.
method.input_contract: Raw request-structure-v1 retains its original 70 private numbers. The legacy fused v5/207-feature contract is unchanged.
method.loss_ablation: Keep the partial binary marginal objective and compare conditional family weight 0 versus 0.2 at the same 300-update budget. Validation recall changed from 68.945% to 69.206%; this is not evidence of a robust generalization solution.
method.optimization: Eleven preregistered configurations: seven initial controls, then four changes justified by validation only. Seed 17, a second seed 29 for the 45-feature ablation, batch 128, lr 0.0003, warmup 15 and cosine to 300 updates. No epoch or parameter increase to force a large-model win.
method.sampling: Use the same 19,741 per-source input views for encoding comparisons. Sample balanced binary classes, negative sources and positive families with replacement. This changes SGD indices, not physical records or reported request counts. RNG and sampler state resume exactly.
method.selection: Validation selection is frozen before scoring the new lab or SR-BH cohort. bounded76-glu17 is a research challenger, not a champion. All 14 evaluated candidates are reported; none is selected from test results.
method.temperature: For a binary score, a strictly monotonic temperature mapping preserves ranking. It cannot improve recall at an equivalent recalibrated FPR operating point. Temperature scaling is not applied as a detection fix.
